scope: Non-independent source/currentness, key, option, second-answer, and single-best-answer QA. Not blind Auditor A/B evidence and not production acceptance.

items.key_concept: SMN2-directed antisense splice modification increasing exon 7 inclusion and full-length SMN protein
items.second_answer_attack: SMN2 copy-number amplification could increase protein quantity but is explicitly excluded; the observed increase in exon 7-containing transcripts uniquely supports splice modification.

items.key_concept: inverse agonism lowers constitutive H3-receptor activity below ligand-free baseline

primary_evidence.title: High constitutive activity of native H3 receptors regulates histamine neurons in brain

items.second_answer_attack: Neutral antagonism blocks agonist effects without suppressing constitutive baseline signaling; therefore option C is not equivalent to inverse agonism.

items.key_concept: FGF23 neutralization restores renal phosphate reabsorption and increases 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D
items.second_answer_attack: PTH influences phosphate handling but does not match the named antibody or the paired renal-phosphate/calcitriol changes directly specified in the label.

items.key_concept: sclerostin inhibition increases bone formation and decreases bone resorption to a lesser extent
items.second_answer_attack: PTH-receptor agonism can also increase bone formation but is not romosozumab's direct target; RANKL is principally an antiresorptive comparator.

items.key_concept: binding IFNAR1 inhibits type I interferon signaling and promotes receptor internalization
items.second_answer_attack: IFN-gamma receptor is a distinct type II interferon receptor and cannot explain selective blockade of type I interferon-responsive gene expression.

items.key_concept: IL-4Ralpha is shared by IL-4 and IL-13 receptor complexes; dupilumab blocks signaling by both cytokines
items.second_answer_attack: Neutralizing IL-13 alone cannot explain the independent inhibition of IL-4 signaling; the shared IL-4Ralpha subunit resolves the item.

items.key_concept: direct binding of epithelial-derived thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP), blocking TSLP-receptor interaction
items.second_answer_attack: IL-5 and IL-13 participate downstream in asthma inflammation, but neither is the directly bound upstream epithelial cytokine.

items.key_concept: IL-5Ralpha binding plus afucosylated-Fc engagement of Fc-gamma-RIII drives ADCC of eosinophils/basophils in vitro
items.second_answer_attack: Soluble IL-5 neutralization can reduce eosinophilic signaling but cannot explain coating of IL-5Ralpha-bearing eosinophils and Fc-gamma-RIII-dependent NK-cell cytotoxicity.

items.key_concept: BCL-2 inhibition displaces proapoptotic proteins, triggering mitochondrial outer-membrane permeabilization and caspase activation
items.second_answer_attack: Options describing membrane stabilization or additional BCL-2 sequestration predict the opposite of the documented apoptotic mechanism; topoisomerase and spindle mechanisms are unrelated direct drug actions.

items.key_concept: active metabolite R406 inhibits SYK-dependent Fc-activating receptor signal transduction and antibody-mediated platelet destruction
items.second_answer_attack: Thrombopoietin-receptor stimulation could increase platelet production clinically, but the assay holds antibody coating constant and directly measures reduced destruction of existing platelets.
